newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BUSINESSMEN INVITED TO INVEST IN UZBEKISTAN.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BUSINESSMEN INVITED TO INVEST IN UZBEKISTAN.

text.p: Visiting Uzbek President Islam Karimov invited Greek businessmen to invest in Uzbekistan and establish closer commercial ties with Uzbek businesses, the semi-official Athens News Agency reported.

Karimov, who is on an official two-day visit to Athens, pointed out the opportunities presented in the field of exploitation of Uzbekistan's gold, oil and natural gas reserves which may be absorbed by Greece during a 90-minute meeting with Athens Chamber and Commerce officials.

Karimov suggested that Greek businessmen use Uzbekistan as a springboard for expansion into neighbouring CIS as well as India, Pakistan and Afghanistan. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301-3311812-4
